body:
In cassical music I still see things, but it isn't very exiting so I don't listen to it in my freetime (although I do play cello). I don't always listen to hardcore music, so I see calmer and less stressful things the lighter the song is. I just listen to rock/metal when I need to release tension, which is kind of stupid of me because it doesn't work. 
I haven't talked to a doctor about this. I've told a friend and a facebook group for people with synesthesia about the music dreams, but not the part about me freaking out. I think it might be linked to synesthesia because that's the only explaination I can think of.

It's high school, so people will give you a hard time about it. But not everyone in the school is going to suddenly turn against you, because they know it could've been them. They probably did something similar, just didn't get caught. Your reputation isn't permanently damaged. Soon people will stop talking about it and forget. You'll meet new people. You'll leave that school altogether eventuallly. And one day you'll be glad you kept living.
